system_prompt_style.note: prompt_explore.txt / prompt_template.txt filled with API doc and memory; sysmsg_tool.json is a static system message.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: a long-term memory that stores distilled trial-and-error experiences from past episodes
context_compaction.note: Short-term memory holds only recent trials (num_stm_slots 4); long-term memory is a distilled summary.

tool_call_format.note: ReAct-style text with JSON args parsed by the harness.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: change the ```run_tool``` function in ```main.py``` to enable the execution of newly-added tools.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: install [ToolBench](https://github.com/OpenBMB/ToolBench), [BMTools](https://github.com/OpenBMB/BMTools) and acquire the associated API keys
protocol_standardization.note: RapidAPI/BMTools calls only; no MCP/A2A in file tree.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: we adopt the ReAct format (Yao et al., 2023) where during each step, the LLM first verbalizes its internal thought, then makes an action (API call) and observes the corresponding execution feedback
loop_primitives.note: 15 episodes x 4 trials constitute repeated independent attempts.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: the LLM first verbalizes its internal thought, then makes an action (API call)
planning_granularity.note: No plan object; paper notes planning is out of scope.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: we use ChatGPT (16k-0613) for exploration and paraphrasing, and GPT-4 ( 8k-0613) (OpenAI, 2023) for final example filtering.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Then, we perform filtering by using GPT-4 to judge the validity of each ex- ample, and then paraphrase the valid examples
delegation_mechanism.note: Separate postprocessing script, not an in-loop delegation tool.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: the LLM interacts with the API within a budget in order to gain as much information as possible about the API
human_in_loop.note: Fully automated exploration; only manual correction of the test set.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: a short-term memory consisting of recent trial trajectories encourages learning from fine-grained successes and failures

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: the long-term memory records the past-explored queries and whether they were judged as successfully fulfilled
long_term_memory.note: Persisted trial trajectories reused across episodes and distilled into a demonstration pool (skill-library-like).

state_persistence.note: Results written to disk; no documented resume path.

self_verification.evidence_quote: the model responds to the user’s query and self-reflects on whether the ex- plored query is successfully fulfilled or not.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: the exploration stage lasts for 15 episodes with 4 trials per episode

rollback.evidence_quote: the LLM interacts with the tool and progressively gathers tool-use experiences through trial and error
rollback.note: Read-only-ish API calls; no revert mechanism registered.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: repeats the thought→action→observation process until the model decides that the API call has returned ade- quate information or a predefined maximum num- ber of calls

cost_controls.note: No cost/budget or caching flags exposed.

timeouts.evidence_quote: We filter down to the APIs that are free to use with low execution latency.

execution_isolation.note: Actions are remote REST API calls from a local Python process.
